question_or_target: Implement tools/council/artifacts/store.py as an append-only event store from which the full transcript, vote history and confidence trajectory are derived views, supporting pause/resume and deterministic replay. Falsifiable question: can the entire council state be rebuilt from the event log alone, with no side state, and does replay of the same log reproduce the same final artifact byte for byte?

residual_unknowns.claim: Live model-call transcripts are recorded-but-not-reproducible from the model; this store reproduces the recorded payloads byte for byte, not a fresh sample from a vendor API.
